sources.title: Waste batteries: emissions monitoring and limits appropriate measures

sources.title: Landfill methane: measurement and metrics
sources.guard: Research on methane measurement methods is authoritative method evidence, not a site-specific parcel measurement unless an explicit result and site scope are present.

sources.title: Voluntary monitoring, reporting and verification period for waste incineration
sources.guard: MRV participation and scope establish reporting obligations, not verified emissions quantities for a cadastral parcel.

sources.title: Environmental permitting guidance: waste incineration
sources.guard: Permit class, BAT and regulatory scope must remain distinct from actual monitored emissions and parcel attribution.

sources.title: Monitoring stack emissions: standards for continuous monitoring and sampling
sources.guard: CEMS, DAHS, LTS and PEMS standards are measurement-quality controls, not the measured value itself.

sources.title: Monitoring stack emissions: environmental permits
sources.guard: Method hierarchy and MCERTS requirements provide provenance and QA context only; validated result values are still required.

sources.title: Waste batteries: emissions control appropriate measures
sources.guard: Abatement, containment and emissions-inventory controls must not be interpreted as measured release quantities.

sources.title: UK ETS: technical guidance and tools
sources.guard: Factors, templates and scheme rules are calculation inputs and reporting controls; they need compatible activity data and verified installation scope.

sources.title: Greenhouse gas reporting: conversion factors 2026
sources.guard: 2026 conversion factors are not observations; require compatible activity data, units, factor vintage, scope and provenance.

sources.title: Voluntary MRV period for EfW and waste incineration - detailed guidance
sources.guard: MRV-only participation does not itself establish verified annual emissions or parcel binding.

sources.title: Monitoring stack emissions: low risk MCPs and specified generators
sources.guard: Certified monitoring approaches, uncertainty limits and SO2 calculation methods are not substitute observations.

sources.title: Waste operations and installations: assessing and scoring environmental permit compliance
sources.guard: Compliance scores and non-compliance categories are regulatory assessments, not physical greenhouse-gas measurements.

sources.title: Manage your UK Emissions Trading Scheme reporting
sources.guard: Reporting-service workflow status, permits and submissions are administrative evidence; verified report contents are required for an emissions claim.

sources.title: Part B activities: combustion and incineration permits
sources.guard: Applicability, permit class and pollutant limits are not annual measured GHG quantities.

sources.title: Check if you need an environmental permit
sources.guard: Permit applicability identifies regulated activities but does not quantify emissions or prove parcel geometry.

sources.title: Select a waste recovery or disposal method for your environmental permit
sources.guard: Recovery/disposal method scores and BAT choices are decision evidence, not emissions measurements.

sources.title: Waste incinerator plant: apply for R1 status
sources.guard: R1 energy-efficiency status and acceptance-test requirements must not be converted into actual GHG emissions or avoided-emission claims.

sources.title: Landfill methane: measurement and metrics: summary
sources.guard: Method-study findings and methane context are not site-specific measured flux unless explicit result, method, uncertainty and site scope are available.

sources.title: Participating in the UK ETS
sources.guard: Scheme participation, surrender deadlines and installation scope do not by themselves establish an emissions quantity for a parcel.

sources.title: Landfill operators: monitor and report your performance
sources.guard: Landfill monitoring requirements and surface-flux standards are distinct from a specific survey result; require observed flux, zone, area, time and geometry.

sources.title: Monitoring stack emissions: techniques and standards for periodic monitoring
sources.guard: Periodic monitoring standards and method implementation documents are QA metadata, not monitored concentration or mass values.

sources.title: Incinerator Annual Monitoring Reporting
sources.guard: The dataset is a high-value measurement candidate surface, but individual annual report rows must be extracted, unit-checked and geometry-bound before parcel promotion.

sources.title: Air emissions risk assessment for your environmental permit
sources.guard: PC and PEC screening/model results are impact estimates, not direct stack or parcel emissions observations.

sources.title: Control and monitor emissions for your environmental permit
sources.guard: Permit conditions and monitoring obligations define control requirements; actual certified results are required for measured emissions claims.

sources.title: Hydrogen production with carbon capture: emerging techniques
sources.guard: Hydrogen production, capture design and LDAR requirements must remain separate from measured fugitive methane/hydrogen and captured/stored/emitted CO2 quantities.

sources.title: Specified generator: apply for an environmental permit
sources.guard: Permit application and decarbonisation-readiness declarations do not prove actual capture, hydrogen conversion or emissions performance.

sources.title: Apply for an environmental permit
sources.guard: Application workflow is administrative evidence only and cannot establish physical emissions or parcel ownership.

sources.title: Medium combustion plant: apply for an environmental permit
sources.guard: MCP screening, hydrogen-firing scope and permit information must not be promoted to observed annual GHG without compatible measured activity and result evidence.
